biography: I am a secondary education teacher specialising in Technology and Computer Science. I hold a Bachelor’s degree in Multimedia and a Master’s degree in Secondary Education Teacher Training. My academic and professional interests focus on responsible AI in education, AI literacy, human-centred AI and the ethical evaluation of AI-supported teaching and assessment practices. In summer 2026, I undertook international training in Trustworthy AI, Digital Humanism, AI ethics and responsible decision-making at the European Summer School on Artificial Intelligence (ESSAI) and the Digital Humanism Summer School in Vienna.
